title: Cheesy Venezuelan Kissed Tagine Bread
description: A sweet and savory twist on traditional German bread, inspired by Venezuelan flavors and German techniques.

ingredients.name: kissed
ingredients.notes: Venezuelan kissed dough or substitute with sweet dough

ingredients.name: venezuelan
ingredients.notes: Venezuelan cheese or substitute with mozzarella

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.notes: German cheese or substitute with cheddar

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: Venezuelan tagine spice or substitute with cumin

instructions: Knead the kissed dough for 5 minutes.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Spread the venezuelan cheese and German cheese evenly over the dough.
Sprinkle the tagine spice over the cheese.
Roll the dough into a log shape and cut into 12 equal pieces.
Place the pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
